name: Hayasaka Akihito
source: Akihito is the childhood friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c11966]Yuika[/url] and the older brother of [url=https://vndb.org/c11964]Umi[/url]. He used to attend another school, named Takamiya Academy, last year until it closed due to financial difficulties. He is the only male student in his class. His class (2-V) is also called "Soleil".
